text:
maria: Quick heads-up — nightly perf CI on `starlight` (d0) flagged a p95 regression for the small-batch bench. ~30% higher than our baseline.

bench-bot: perf-alert: suite=small-batch, run=nightly-2026-03-18-03:00, p95_delta=+29.7%, artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/runs/5098765432

owen: ack. Do we have a suspected range/commit? Any config flips overnight? :thinking_face:

maria: commit `a7c3d1f` rolled around 02:10 UTC. No infra flags changed in the deploy log. I attached the failing sample trace in artifacts.

jin: eyeballing the trace — looks like KV-cache eviction spikes and a lot more CPU time spent in the kv-serialize path. Could be eviction threshold regression.

sarah: pinging infra — @devops-lgtm any chance the node pool had different kernel params or a kernel upgrade?

devops-lgtm: We're on the same AMI; no kernel bump. We did rotate a subset of instances (pool alpha) 01:55–02:05 UTC for a security patch. I'm running a quick diff on sysctl and docker runtime flags now.

owen: while you check infra, I'll try a local repro with the failing sample. maria — can you paste the repro command?

maria: sure — run this locally against the bench harness:```bash
BENCH_SUITE=small-batch ./run_bench --commit a7c3d1f --samples=500 --seed=42 --collect-pprof
```
Expect higher p95 compared to `--commit a7c3d1e` (previous). The artifact includes pprof and the bench runner log.

bench-bot: artifact: https://artifacts.internal/runs/5098765432/pprof.tar.gz (pprof CPU + flamegraphs)

jin: grabbing it now. If it's eviction, try toggling `KV_CACHE_MAX_SIZE` in the harness to see sensitivity. Might reproduce without full infra.

owen: I'll kick off a quick bisect between a7c3d1e..a7c3d1f and run on a small matrix (seed 42, 100 samples) — low-cost. Will post results in ~30m.

devops-lgtm: infra diff: only change was instance rotation; container runtime and sysctl identical. No oom events.

maria: thanks — assigning ownership: owen owns the bisect, jin owns the profiling deep-dive if bisect points to serialization area. I'll keep monitoring and escalate to eng-runtime leads if we don't have a narrow culprit in 2h.

owen: started bisect job: CI link https://ci.internal/bisect/5098765432. If anyone wants to run locally, repro command in the job description.

jin: quick note — when you repro, capture `perf record` with `-g` so we can get callchain for the serialize path. I want both user and kernel stacks.

maria: if bisect hits something, let's prefer a revert + patch workflow for overnight rollback to avoid customer impact.

nowen: (typo) owen: updated — bisect found the likely commit at `a7c3d1f` (first suspect). Running confirm runs now.

bench-bot: bisect-update: suspect_commit=a7c3d1f, confirm_runs=3/3, p95_delta=+30.1%

jin: confirmed on pprof — heavy tail in `kv_serialize::encode_entry` and increased syscalls around `writev`. Looks reproducible.

maria: good catch. Can someone open a quick PR to revert the offending change and add a micro-benchmark for kv-serialize? Prefer minimal revert gated by unit tests + micro-bench.

owen: opening PR now — https://git.internal/r/reverts/1234 — adding repro in CI. assigning @jin for review.

jin: reviewing, will add a micro-bench and run locally against both commits.

devops-lgtm: after revert lands, I'll trigger a canary replay across pool alpha first.

maria: timeline: try to get revert merged in the next 90m, canary in next 2h. If all green, we'll roll to production.

sarah: noted — I'll draft a short incident note for postmortem tracking (root cause: serialization change regressed KV cache behavior).

maria: thanks team. If anything blocks the bisect or PR, ping me directly. :thumbsup:

nowen: (minor followup) adding the exact bench config to the PR description so folks can reproduce locally.

bench-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled: https://deploys.internal/canary/5098765432 (pending revert merge)

maria: wrap-up — we have ownerships, a revert in flight, infra check cleared, and profiling confirming the hotspot. I'll update eng leads after merge. Night crew — thanks for the quick sync.

owen: evening y'all.

jin: gnight :zzz:
